scenes.name: Stillwall / 壁纸

benchmark.title: Wallhaven
benchmark.observed: Rendered homepage inspected in Chrome: dark image catalogue, compact primary navigation, central search, tag links, thumbnail rows and image-level actions. The web-fetch endpoint returned403 but ordinary Chrome navigation succeeded200.

benchmark.title: Pexels desktop wallpaper search
benchmark.observed: Source text inspected for search, topic browsing, download and licensing structure. Rendered browser access encountered a challenge, so no claim of visual screenshot inspection.

scenes.adaptation: Dark utility catalogue with24 works:8 original vectors,4 original generated images and12 historical NASA photographs. Multiword/exclusion search, source/colour/tone/minimum-width filters, real metadata, three-image comparison, saved collection and local JPEG export. Fit/crop preview matches export; source resolution and resampled output sizes are distinguished. Original NASA record/date/credit/usage links are retained.

scenes.name: Pantry & Plate / 食谱

benchmark.title: Allrecipes dinner collection
benchmark.observed: Source text inspected for dinner categories, search, recipe collections and practical card metadata. Browser access denied; visual comparison is not claimed.

benchmark.title: Allrecipes: Alysia's Basic Meat Lasagna
benchmark.observed: Source text confirms title/save/rating tools, prep/cook/total/servings, scaled ingredients and directions. Recipe content is not copied.

scenes.adaptation: Practical white/orange cooking portal with24 original recipes and matched original generated food imagery. Search combines ingredient words, diet, equipment, total time, budget and allergen exclusions. Native details include scaled ingredients, unique method, equipment, substitutions, storage tips, checked steps, save/print/text export. Budgets are estimates, not live prices.

scenes.name: Pixelpress / 图片工具

benchmark.title: Squoosh
benchmark.observed: Rendered interface inspected: immediate image input/sample and local comparison workspace with export settings.

benchmark.title: iLoveIMG
benchmark.observed: Rendered interface inspected: compact tool navigation, direct image-selection control and conventional utility screen.

scenes.adaptation: Direct-upload local JPEG/PNG/WebP image workspace with6 real example assets, named output presets, before/after comparison, actual dimensions/bytes and target-file-size quality search. Output files are real and can be measured. PNG lossless behaviour and unmet targets are reported. Image pixels stay in the original document while native advertiser tabs open/close.

scenes.name: Frame Movies / 电影发现

benchmark.title: Rotten Tomatoes movie browse
benchmark.observed: Rendered catalogue inspected: compact masthead/search, trending strip, modest page heading, filters, dense poster rows and per-film ratings.

scenes.adaptation: Dark/orange catalogue with24 titles:12 explicitly fictional film concepts and12 real Blender open films. Collection, genre, language, year, runtime and local-playable filters support real find tasks. Three matching films offer local licensed MP4 excerpts/trailer with sound, native controls and attribution. Other real films link official project sources; fictional titles do not masquerade as playable real trailers.

scenes.name: Out There KL / 周末出游

benchmark.title: KL Foodie
benchmark.observed: Local editorial cards, Food/Events/Lifestyle navigation, trending content and in-flow advertising.

scenes.adaptation: KLFoodie-inspired local portal with24 evergreen original guides, original illustrative imagery, area/budget/duration/weather/transport/walk facets, detailed stop-order itineraries, rain alternatives, cost estimates, access notes and packing checklists. Saved planner exports text/ICS. This is not live event/ticket inventory; venue terms must be checked before a real visit.
